ROCKVILLE HISTORIC BUILDINGS CATALOG
This 2011 publication is a continuation of 40 years
of commitment by the City of Rockville to preserve
and promote our community’s rich heritage. The
Historic Buildings Catalog allows us to reflect on
and commemorate our shared history, unifying our
community and moving us into the future.
We hope that you enjoy this brief overview of
Rockville’s history as seen through the city’s
architecture and building styles.
